genomes.name: Capitulation Close
genomes.thesis: A 4% down day that closes in the bottom quarter of its range on 1.3x volume is a capitulation print; the leveraged fund is usually bought back within two sessions.
genomes.rationale: The strongest single setup found: profitable on every window including the 2x single-stock pairs, with no trend filter needed.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.04 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) < 0.25 and volume_ratio > 1.3

genomes.name: Red Day Above the 50
genomes.thesis: A 4.5% down day while the fund is still above its 50-day mean is a dip inside a trend, not a breakdown; take 3% or two bars.
genomes.rationale: The trend gate is what makes a plain red-day buy survive the single-stock funds, where an ungated red day loses.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.045 and close > sma50 and volume_ratio > 1.0

genomes.name: Oversold Dip Above the 50
genomes.thesis: A 7-bar RSI under 40 with the fund above its 50-day mean: multi-day selling inside an uptrend, sold into the first bounce.
genomes.rationale: RSI thresholds have to be scaled for 3x products: under 25 almost never fires above the 50-day; under 40 does, and it is the best risk-adjusted setup out of sample.

genomes.name: Pullback Cluster
genomes.thesis: Two consecutive red closes and a 3% loss over five sessions, above the 50-day mean, on above-average volume: a short, sharp pullback that mean-reverts.
genomes.rationale: The volume gate matters: the same rule without it is flat on the long Nasdaq history.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < 0 and prev(ret1) < 0 and ret5 < -0.03 and close > sma50 and volume_ratio > 1.1

genomes.name: Prior-Low Break on Volume
genomes.thesis: A close below yesterday's low, above the 50-day mean, on 1.2x volume: a one-day shakeout that is bought back.
genomes.rationale: Highest trade count of the single setups; without the volume gate it is a loser, so the volume is the signal.

entry_rules.when: close < prev(low) and close > sma50 and volume_ratio > 1.2

genomes.name: Combo: Capitulation or Oversold
genomes.thesis: Trade the two best setups as one book: capitulation prints in any regime, oversold dips only above the 50-day. Five 20% slots.
genomes.rationale: More trades and a smoother curve than either setup alone; the best held-out profit factor and win rate of the two combos.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.04 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) < 0.25 and volume_ratio > 1.3

genomes.name: Combo: All Five Setups
genomes.thesis: Every setup above in one agent, first match wins, five 20% slots. The most active book and the broadest evidence base.
genomes.rationale: About 60 trades a year on the Nasdaq universe and the best held-out Sharpe of the set; use it when you want the signal every week rather than every month.
